boundary: Steady synthetic full updates, 3 warmups plus 5 repeats; shared-device observations, not generated-token throughput or full-TIDE acceleration.

choice.reason: B32 more than doubles HB88 B16 throughput; B64/128 further improve throughput but would change optimizer update count at fixed exposure. Keep declared B32 for this bounded quality study and use independent devices for candidate/seed parallelism. Larger global batches remain a separate recipe experiment.
